sourceTitle: Protein Iced Coffee (Low Carb, Sugar Free, THM-S)
sourceText:
Protein Iced Coffee (Low Carb, Sugar Free, THM-S)
By: Aleena Grace
Published: Sunday, June 4, 2017 - 12:17pm

Ingredients




2 1/2 Cups Brewed Coffee (Cooled)
1 Scoop Chocolate Pristine Whey Protein Powder (or your favorite protein powder)
1 Tablespoon Omega PowerCreamer

Preparation

1 Blend all ingredients in a blender (or use an Electric Milk Frother). 2 Pour over ice and enjoy!

About

A creamy iced coffee full of health-boosting benefits, and 20 grams of protein!
